Name: Polycarp
Summary: Bishop of Smyrna in Asia Minor, a respected elder of the second-century church who was martyred in old age.
Contribution: His letter to the Philippians commended steadfast faith and warned against false teaching, while the early account of his martyrdom became a model narrative of courageous witness that later Christians read and honoured.
Testimony: At his trial he refused to deny Christ, saying he had served him for many decades and would not revile his King and Saviour.
